6.source: Rewritten 2026-11-22 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text was a loose paraphrase), checked against the Hebrew, at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses, and no sentence over 14 words (sentence-length pass 2026-11-23). V3 keeps the KJV's I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down.

verses.text: Now Sanballat, and Tobiah, and Geshem the Arabian heard. The rest of our enemies heard too. They heard that I (Nehemiah) had builded (built) the wall. There was no breach (gap) left in it. But at that time I had not set up the doors upon the gates.
Then Sanballat and Geshem sent to me, saying: Come, let us meet together. Let us meet in one of the villages in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief (harm).
And I sent messengers to them, saying: I am doing a great work, so that I cannot come down. Why should the work cease (stop) while I leave it and come down to you?
Yet they sent to me 4 times after this sort (in this way). And I answered them after the same manner (the same way).
Then Sanballat sent his servant to me in like manner (the same way) the 5th time. He had an open letter in his hand.

In it was written: It is reported among the heathen (nations), and Gashmu (Geshem) says it. The report is that you and the Jews think to rebel. For that cause you build the wall. You build it so that you may be their king, according to these words.

And you have also appointed prophets to preach of you at Jerusalem. They say: There is a king in Judah. And now it shall be reported to the king according to these words. Come now therefore, and let us take counsel (talk) together.
Then I sent to him, saying: There are no such things done as you say. But you feign (make) them up out of your own heart.
For they all made us afraid. They said: Their hands shall be weakened from the work, so that it be not done. Now therefore, O God, strengthen my hands.

Afterward I came to the house of Shemaiah. He was the son of Delaiah the son of Mehetabeel. Shemaiah was shut up. And he said: Let us meet together in the house of God, within the temple. Let us shut the doors of the temple. For they will come to slay (kill) you. Yes, in the night will they come to slay you.
And I said: Should such a man as I flee (run away)? Being as I am, would I go into the temple to save my life? I will not go in.
And look, I perceived (understood) that God had not sent him. He pronounced this prophecy against me. For Tobiah and Sanballat had hired him.
He was hired to make me afraid, so I would do so and sin. It was so they might have matter for an evil report. It was so they might reproach (shame) me.
My God, think on Tobiah and Sanballat according to these their works. Think on the prophetess Noadiah, and the rest of the prophets. They would have put me in fear.
The wall was finished in the 25th day of the month Elul. It took 52 days.

And it came to pass, when all our enemies heard of it. All the heathen (nations) that were about us saw these things. They were much cast down in their own eyes (lost their courage). For they perceived (understood) that this work was wrought (done) of our God.
Moreover (also) in those days the nobles (important men) of Judah sent many letters to Tobiah. And the letters of Tobiah came to them.

For there were many in Judah sworn to him (who had promised to be loyal to him). He was the son in law of Shechaniah the son of Arah. And his son Johanan had taken the daughter of Meshullam the son of Berechiah.
Also they reported his good deeds before me, and uttered (told) my words to him. And Tobiah sent letters to put me in fear.
